title: Adversarial training reduces adaptive white-box PGD success

invariants.description: PGD L∞ ε=0.3 must still evade the undefended model.
A new PGD attack using the defended model's gradients must succeed on at most 30% of correctly classified inputs. This is a reduction, not immunity.

rationale: Adaptive evaluation: the attacker has white-box access to the adversarially trained model.
